ONE file, read in place by the PGlite checks (tools/pglite_check/photo_files*.mjs, against the real SQL), the photo-files and push function tests (supabase/functions/*/..._test.ts), the reference choosers and rules (tools/photo_lines) and Desktop 2's tests; copied byte for byte, LF, to Portal 2 (tests/vectors/photo_files_cases.json) and DCR Agents 2 (tests/data/photo_files_cases.json), whose checks compare their copy's SHA-256 with photo_files_cases.sha256 beside this file (tools/photo_lines/cases_sha.mjs). Each section says which implementation answers it (runners). Made-up values only: the test job A267, made-up people (Lou Martel, Sam Ortiz, Ana Ruiz, Pat, Otto, Olive), addresses at example.com or example.test, the OneDrive host example-my.sharepoint.com with the personal path office_example_com, item ids and quickXorHash values starting FAKE (the qx section's hashes are real hashes of made-up bytes), GUIDs of zeros. ... read again 5 minutes on, still another hash: still waiting

confirmed before, missing, its file back without a hash yet: waiting for the hash, never confirmed on the size

confirmed before, missing, a file of ANOTHER size there without a hash yet: mismatch, missing_since cleared (rules 4 and 7)
a pending Replace whose item still shows the old version (its cTag as last read): waiting, never broken_upload (rule 3)
a pending Replace whose item shows a new cTag but still the old hash: waiting (rule 3)

the broken_upload resend whose item now shows the row's OWN size and hash, its cTag still the one last read (OneDrive's hash settled after the 30 minutes): confirmed, the Replace ended - rule 3 never holds the row's own bytes (rules 3 and 5; review round 3)

files.moved_out: The shoot's folder is no longer inside DCR Photo & Video (moved or deleted in OneDrive) - ask the office to put it back or restore it from OneDrive's recycle bin.
files.job_moved_out: The job folder '{name}' is no longer inside DCR Photo & Video (moved or deleted in OneDrive), so nothing can be handed in to its new shoots - ask the office to put it back. Gone for good? After 7 days an admin can retire it, and files handed in then go into a new job folder.
files.busy: The last check couldn't finish (OneDrive was busy) - DCR checks again at {time}.
files.too_big: This folder has more than 10,000 files or 100 folders - DCR can't check it in one go. Tell the office.
files.retired: DCR stopped using this shoot's old folder - an admin retired it ({reason}). Files handed in now go into a new folder.
files.too_many_tries: {name} won't start sending - DCR tries again tomorrow by itself.
files.too_many_tries_phone: {name} won't start sending - pick it again tomorrow.
files.no_access: Only the marketing team can open the shoot folders in OneDrive.
files.access_waiting: The office hasn't given your Microsoft account access to DCR Photo & Video yet - Open in OneDrive shows here once they have.
files.access_not_company: Your Microsoft account isn't a DCR Framing account - ask the office to fix it on the Photo team.
files.title: Files
files.read_failed: The files couldn't be read - check the connection, then try again.
files.not_available: Photo files in OneDrive aren't switched on yet.

files_buttons._about: Button labels of the Files section and its sheets (Desktop 2; the phone's where noted in OD §3.3).

files_list._about: The file list's group headers (Desktop 2's drawer, photo_shoot_files_page), in this order; an empty group is not shown.
files_list.hidden: None of the files are in the groups shown - turn on a group above to see them.

completion._about: The line under the Files line: what the shoot needs before marketing hears about it (photo_drive_status.completion, app.photo_completion_code; the cases' completion section maps every ready_why). No code: no line.
completion.not_done: The files are in OneDrive - mark the shoot done to send it to marketing.
completion.closed_files: This shoot was marked {skipped_or_missed}, but its files are in OneDrive - mark it done to bring it back and send it to marketing.
completion.closed_old_pc: DCR Agents 2 on the office computer can't bring this shoot back yet - press Mark done again once DCR Agents 2 is updated, or ask the office to mark it done there.
completion.closed_plan: This shoot was marked {skipped_or_missed} and its photo plan is closed - ask the office to bring the plan back in DCR Agents 2, then mark the shoot done.
completion.done_sent: Marked done - waiting for the office computer. Marketing is told once it's applied and the files are in OneDrive.
completion.root_problem: Done - marketing is told once DCR can reach DCR Photo & Video in OneDrive again (Settings → Photo & Video).
completion.folder_problem: Done - marketing is told once this shoot's folder is back in DCR Photo & Video.
completion.job_folder_problem: Done - marketing is told once its job folder is back in DCR Photo & Video (ask the office).
completion.job_folder_no_hand_in: Done - hand its files in once its job folder is back in DCR Photo & Video (ask the office).
completion.done_copying: Done - marketing is told once the files are handed in.
completion.no_hand_in: Done - hand the files in from DCR Desktop to send it to marketing.
completion.files_problem: Done - marketing is told once the files above are sorted out.
completion.done_waiting: Done - marketing is told once the files are in OneDrive.
completion.no_media: No photo or video is in OneDrive yet - marketing is told once one is.
completion.check_old: Done - DCR checks the files in OneDrive once more before it tells marketing.
completion.withdrawn: Taken off the marketing list - the shoot isn't done any more.
completion.phone_done_hint: Marketing hears about it once the files are in OneDrive.
completion.bring_back_sheet: This marks the {skipped_or_missed} shoot done and sends its files to marketing. Its task on My Tasks stays closed.

file_state._about: One file's state in the file list (photo_shoot_files_page): its state, and while it waits its sending step - the PC showing the list's own journal step first (a file it sends now), else its upload_step (to_send: waiting, session: sending, committed: checking); stalled: a waiting row whose own stalled is true (app.photo_row_stalled); lost_here: a waiting file still to send that the PC showing the list lost (its outbox copy gone, changed or unreadable, or a left-out file put back after its copy was deleted - OD §3.2.6, §25, §26). Each word is at most 50 characters: whole in the file list's words column.
file_state.lost_here: Can't be read here - copy it again from the card

copy._about: Desktop 2 while it copies into its outbox and sends to OneDrive (OD §3.2), and the phone's own lines (big_phone, keep_screen, not_media, pick_limit; OD §3.3); the codes are photo_upload_files' per-file codes, the sender's and Desktop 2's own checks. {left}: the time left (OD §3.2.8).
copy.skipped_same: {n} files were already here and were skipped.
copy.skipped_same_one: 1 file was already here and was skipped.
copy.renamed: {n} files had the same name as different files already here and were saved as … (2).
copy.renamed_one: 1 file had the same name as a different file already here and was saved as … (2).
copy.done: The copy into {shoot} is finished: {n} files copied.
copy.done_one: The copy into {shoot} is finished: 1 file copied.
copy.done_none: The copy into {shoot} is finished: there was nothing new to copy.
copy.done_card: The memory card can come out - keep its files until this shoot says ✓.
copy.done_keep: Keep the original files until this shoot says ✓.
copy.done_left_out: The {n} files left out aren't sent to OneDrive, and the ✓ never counts them - keep them. Keep the others until this shoot says ✓.
copy.done_left_out_one: The file left out isn't sent to OneDrive, and the ✓ never counts it - keep it. Keep the others until this shoot says ✓.
copy.done_card_left_out: The memory card can come out. The {n} files left out aren't sent to OneDrive, and the ✓ never counts them - keep them. Keep the card's other files until this shoot says ✓.
copy.done_card_left_out_one: The memory card can come out. The file left out isn't sent to OneDrive, and the ✓ never counts it - keep it. Keep the card's other files until this shoot says ✓.
copy.send_left: Sending to OneDrive: about {left} left. Leave this computer on with DCR Desktop open.
copy.send_working: Sending to OneDrive - the time left shows once it's started. Leave this computer on with DCR Desktop open.
copy.cancelled: The copy into {shoot} is cancelled. Nothing of it is handed in, and DCR's copy waiting on this computer is deleted.
copy.cancelled_sent: Cancelled. {n} files had already reached OneDrive - they stay in the shoot's folder; ask the office to delete them if they aren't wanted.
copy.cancelled_sent_one: Cancelled. 1 file had already reached OneDrive - it stays in the shoot's folder; ask the office to delete it if it isn't wanted.
copy.cancelled_elsewhere: The hand-in into {shoot} is cancelled. Nothing of it is handed in.
copy.replace_ask: Replace {n} files in OneDrive with these? OneDrive keeps the ones there now as older versions (they use space).
copy.replace_ask_one: Replace 1 file in OneDrive with this one? OneDrive keeps the one there now as an older version (it uses space).
copy.replace_list: {n} files have the same name as different files already here. Each is sent as … (2) - turn on Replace for a file only to write over the one in OneDrive.
copy.replace_list_one: 1 file has the same name as a different file already here. It's sent as … (2) - turn on Replace only to write over the one in OneDrive.
copy.card_folder: Put this card's files in a folder of their own (optional):
copy.no_card: No memory card found - put it in, then open this again, or choose its folder.
copy.check_first_rest: Checking what's already handed in, so nothing is copied twice…
copy.money: Rename '{name}' first: file and folder names can't hold amounts.
copy.bad_char: Left out: '{name}' has a character Windows or OneDrive can't use.
copy.trailing: Left out: '{name}' starts with a space or ends with a space or a dot.
copy.reserved_name: Left out: '{name}' is a name Windows or OneDrive keeps for itself.
copy.reserved_prefix: Left out: '{name}' starts with _dcr- (DCR's own files).
copy.too_deep: Left out: '{path}' is more than 3 folders deep.
copy.too_long: Left out: '{path}' is too long - shorten the folder or file names.
copy.link_folder: Left out: '{path}' is a link to another folder - copy that folder itself.
copy.too_many_files: This shoot already has 5,000 files - start another shoot for the rest.
copy.no_room: Not copied: this computer needs {need} free on {disk} and has {free}. Copy part of the card, or pick another disk in Settings → Photo & Video.
copy.no_room_ask: Not copied: this computer needs {need} free on {disk} and has {free}. Copy part of the card, or ask the office to pick another disk for this computer.
copy.sync_root: That folder is inside a synced folder (OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive) - pick a folder outside it.
copy.stopped_space: The copy stopped: this computer has under 2 GB free. DCR frees room as files reach OneDrive - press Copy the rest once there is room.
copy.stopped_part: Copied what fits on this computer for now. Keep the memory card: press Copy the rest once sending has made room.
copy.room_onedrive: OneDrive has about {free} left for photos - this card needs {need}. The files wait on this computer if OneDrive fills.
copy.count_mismatch: Some files didn't reach DCR's list - sending them again.
copy.card_other: Not copied: {n} .{ext} files on the card aren't photos or videos.
copy.card_other_one: Not copied: 1 .{ext} file on the card isn't a photo or video.
copy.unreadable: Not copied yet: '{name}' couldn't be read from the card or folder.
copy.unread_folder: Not copied yet: the files in '{path}' couldn't be read from the card or folder.
copy.unread_not_here: Not on this card or folder: '{name}', which couldn't be read last time.
copy.rest_not_here: This isn't the card or folder this copy started from: {n} of its files aren't copied yet, and the copy stops before handing in until they are.
copy.rest_not_here_one: This isn't the card or folder this copy started from: 1 of its files isn't copied yet, and the copy stops before handing in until it is.
copy.rest_some_not_here: {n} files this copy hasn't reached yet aren't on this card or folder - the copy stops before handing in until they're copied from the one it started from.
copy.rest_some_not_here_one: 1 file this copy hasn't reached yet isn't on this card or folder - the copy stops before handing in until it's copied from the one it started from.
copy.rest_card: the card this copy started from
copy.closed_card: the card this computer copied from
copy.closed_card_note: The card this computer copied from goes where its first part went - the folder above is for another card.
copy.queued: Waiting for the copy into {shoot} to finish - this one starts right after it.
copy.stopped_source: The copy stopped: the memory card or folder it copies from can't be read any more. Put it back, then press Copy the rest.
copy.stopped_target: The copy stopped: DCR can't write its copy on this computer any more (the disk is full, gone or locked). Press Copy the rest once it's back.
copy.stopped_offline: The copy stopped: DCR couldn't reach the server. Press Copy the rest once this computer is back online.
copy.stopped_closed: The copy stopped: it was handed in or cancelled on another computer. Files it copied after that aren't handed in.
copy.stopped_closed_rest: The copy stopped: it was handed in or cancelled on another computer, and {n} files of the card or folder weren't copied - copy the card or folder again.
copy.stopped_closed_rest_one: The copy stopped: it was handed in or cancelled on another computer, and 1 file of the card or folder wasn't copied - copy the card or folder again.
copy.stopped_unreadable: The copy stopped before handing in: {n} files couldn't be read from the card or folder. Press Copy the rest to try them again.
copy.stopped_unreadable_one: The copy stopped before handing in: 1 file couldn't be read from the card or folder. Press Copy the rest to try it again.
copy.stopped_unlisted: The copy stopped before handing in: part of the card or folder couldn't be read. Press Copy the rest to try it again.
copy.stopped_rest: The copy stopped before handing in: {n} files of the card or folder it started from aren't copied yet. Press Copy the rest with that card or folder, or Hand in what's there to hand in without them.
copy.stopped_rest_one: The copy stopped before handing in: 1 file of the card or folder it started from isn't copied yet. Press Copy the rest with that card or folder, or Hand in what's there to hand in without it.
copy.rest_left: {n} files of the card or folder it started from aren't copied yet.
copy.rest_left_one: 1 file of the card or folder it started from isn't copied yet.
copy.rest_closed: {n} files of the card or folder this computer copied from never reached this shoot: its copy was handed in or cancelled on another computer without them. Copy the card or folder again - the files already here are skipped.
copy.rest_closed_one: 1 file of the card or folder this computer copied from never reached this shoot: its copy was handed in or cancelled on another computer without it. Copy the card or folder again - the files already here are skipped.
copy.forget_rest_ask: Forget the {n} files this computer never copied? This shoot stops saying so. Keep them on the card or folder until you're sure they aren't needed.
copy.forget_rest_ask_one: Forget the file this computer never copied? This shoot stops saying so. Keep it on the card or folder until you're sure it isn't needed.
copy.stopped_busy: The copy stopped: the server was busy. Press Copy the rest in a minute.
copy.stopped_count: The copy stopped before handing in: DCR's list of its files doesn't match what was copied. Press Copy the rest to send them again.
copy.not_started_offline: Not copied: DCR couldn't reach the server. Copy the files again once this computer is back online.
copy.hand_in_offline: Not handed in yet: DCR couldn't reach the server. Press Hand in what's there again once this computer is back online.
copy.cancel_offline: Not cancelled yet: DCR couldn't reach the server. Press Cancel it again once this computer is back online.
copy.busy_here: A copy into this shoot is running or waiting on this computer - copy this card or folder once that one is handed in.
copy.cancel_ask: Cancel this copy? Nothing of it is handed in, and DCR's copy waiting on this computer is deleted. Files that already reached OneDrive stay there.
copy.cancel_ask_phone: Cancel this upload? Nothing of it is handed in. Files that already reached OneDrive stay there.
copy.cancel_ask_elsewhere: Cancel this copy? Nothing of it is handed in, and DCR's copy waiting on {pc} is deleted. Files that already reached OneDrive stay there.
copy.hand_in_ask: Hand in the {n} files this copy recorded? Anything it hadn't copied yet isn't handed in - copy it later.
copy.hand_in_ask_one: Hand in the 1 file this copy recorded? Anything it hadn't copied yet isn't handed in - copy it later.
copy.hand_in_ask_phone: Hand in the {n} files already in OneDrive? The ones not sent yet aren't handed in - pick them again later.
copy.hand_in_ask_phone_one: Hand in the 1 file already in OneDrive? The ones not sent yet aren't handed in - pick them again later.
copy.keep_drive_ask: Keep the {n} files as they are in OneDrive? DCR counts OneDrive's version as this shoot's from now on, instead of the one that was copied - copy them again instead if OneDrive's is the wrong one.
copy.keep_drive_ask_one: Keep the file as it is in OneDrive? DCR counts OneDrive's version as this shoot's from now on, instead of the one that was copied - copy it again instead if OneDrive's is the wrong one.
copy.leave_out_ask: Leave the {n} files out of this shoot? They stop counting for it, so it can go to marketing without them, and any copy of them DCR still has waiting on this computer is deleted. Put them back from the file list if that was a mistake (then copy them from the card again).
copy.leave_out_ask_one: Leave the file out of this shoot? It stops counting for it, so the shoot can go to marketing without it, and any copy of it DCR still has waiting on this computer is deleted. Put it back from the file list if that was a mistake (then copy it from the card again).
copy.leave_out_ask_pc: Leave the {n} files out of this shoot? They stop counting for it, so it can go to marketing without them, and any copy of them DCR still has waiting on {pc} is deleted. Put them back from the file list if that was a mistake (then copy them from the card again on {pc}).
copy.leave_out_ask_pc_one: Leave the file out of this shoot? It stops counting for it, so the shoot can go to marketing without it, and any copy of it DCR still has waiting on {pc} is deleted. Put it back from the file list if that was a mistake (then copy it from the card again on {pc}).
copy.leave_out_listed_ask: Leave the {n} files out of this shoot? They stop counting for it, and its Files section stops asking about them - the shoot is with marketing already. Put them back from the file list if that was a mistake.
copy.leave_out_listed_ask_one: Leave the file out of this shoot? It stops counting for it, and its Files section stops asking about it - the shoot is with marketing already. Put it back from the file list if that was a mistake.
copy.plan_time: Then DCR sends them to OneDrive: about {left} at this computer's last speed.
copy.plan_time_unknown: DCR works out the time once it starts sending.
copy.nothing_card: Nothing on this card or folder is a photo or video.
copy.nothing_again: None of the files DCR needs again are on this card or folder - pick the one they were copied from.
copy.nothing_unread: Nothing on this card or folder could be read - put it back in, then try again.
copy.nothing_left: Everything on this card or folder is already in this copy - Copy checks it once more before handing it in.
copy.quit_ask: A copy is still running. Quit anyway? It stops here, and Copy the rest finishes it later.
copy.quit_waiting: Quitting drops the {n} copies waiting to start on this computer - copy them again after DCR Desktop opens.
copy.quit_waiting_one: Quitting drops the copy waiting to start on this computer - copy it again after DCR Desktop opens.
copy.quit_sending: DCR is still sending {n} files of {shoot} ({size}). If you quit, it goes on next time DCR Desktop opens.
copy.quit_sending_one: DCR is still sending 1 file of {shoot} ({size}). If you quit, it goes on next time DCR Desktop opens.
copy.sign_out_ask: A copy is still running on this computer - signing out stops it, and Copy the rest finishes it later.
copy.sign_out_waiting: Signing out drops the {n} copies waiting to start on this computer - copy them again after you sign in.
copy.sign_out_waiting_one: Signing out drops the copy waiting to start on this computer - copy it again after you sign in.
copy.sign_out_sending: DCR is still sending {n} files from this computer - signing out pauses it until you or an admin sign in here again.
copy.sign_out_sending_one: DCR is still sending 1 file from this computer - signing out pauses it until you or an admin sign in here again.
copy.recopy_differs: {n} files aren't the same as the ones handed in before - left alone. Copy them as new files if they're wanted.
copy.recopy_differs_one: 1 file isn't the same as the one handed in before - left alone. Copy it as a new file if it's wanted.
copy.left_alone: {n} files are different in OneDrive - left alone. Press Copy again on the shoot's Files line to replace them.
copy.left_alone_one: 1 file is different in OneDrive - left alone. Press Copy again on the shoot's Files line to replace it.
copy.left_culled: {n} files deleted in OneDrive after the shoot went to marketing weren't put back. To put them back, pick them in the file list and press Copy them again.
copy.left_culled_one: 1 file deleted in OneDrive after the shoot went to marketing wasn't put back. To put it back, pick it in the file list and press Copy it again.
copy.recopied: {n} files that were missing in OneDrive were copied again - they're on their way.
copy.recopied_one: 1 file that was missing in OneDrive was copied again - it's on its way.
copy.refilled: {n} files were written back on this computer - they're on their way to OneDrive.
copy.refilled_one: 1 file was written back on this computer - it's on its way to OneDrive.
copy.refill_failed: {n} files couldn't be written back on this computer - something there is holding the old copies. Keep the memory card: press Copy them again later, or Leave them out in the file list.
copy.refill_failed_one: '{name}' couldn't be written back on this computer - something there is holding the old copy. Keep the memory card: press Copy it again later, or Leave it out in the file list.
copy.refill_differs: {n} files on this card aren't the ones handed in - they weren't written back. Keep the memory card and try another card reader, then press Copy them again.
copy.refill_differs_one: '{name}' on this card isn't the one handed in - it wasn't written back. Keep the memory card and try another card reader, then press Copy it again.
copy.sent_again: {n} files were sent again from the start: OneDrive had dropped the half-sent part.
copy.sent_again_one: 1 file was sent again from the start: OneDrive had dropped the half-sent part.
copy.name_taken_sent: {name} was already in OneDrive - sent as {new}.
copy.not_intact: OneDrive got a different copy of {name} twice - try another card reader or computer.
copy.replace_unavailable: OneDrive didn't let DCR replace {name} - keep OneDrive's copy, or leave it out.
copy.not_the_file: That file is not the one handed in - it wasn't used.
copy.big_phone: Big videos go best from DCR Desktop. This {size} video needs about {left} on good Wi-Fi with the screen on.
copy.keep_screen: Keep this screen on and this page open until it says done.
copy.not_media: {n} files aren't photos or videos and weren't added.
copy.not_media_one: 1 file isn't a photo or video and wasn't added.
copy.pick_limit: Pick at most 200 files at a time - add the rest after these are in.

setup._about: Desktop 2's Settings → Photo & Video card (admins; OD §10.2): the health lines first (the health group), then these. {used}, {budget}, {free}: sizes; {pct}: a whole percent.
setup.title: Photo files
setup.storage_no_budget: DCR Photo & Video: {used} - no space is set for it yet.
setup.storage_note: Deleted files keep using space until OneDrive's recycle bin lets them go (93 days).
setup.storage_help: To make room: empty the office OneDrive's recycle bin (and its second stage), move old shoots' videos to other storage, or buy more storage. DCR itself never deletes anything to make room.
setup.budget_label: Space DCR Photo & Video may use (GB)
setup.key_ends: DCR's OneDrive key for photos runs out on {day}.
setup.outbox: Files waiting to upload on this computer: {size} ({n} shoots)
setup.outbox_one: Files waiting to upload on this computer: {size} (1 shoot)
setup.outbox_none: No files are waiting to upload on this computer.
setup.outbox_disk: Keep files waiting to upload on: {disk} ({free} free)
setup.share_give: Give {name} ({account}) access to DCR Photo & Video in OneDrive (Can edit), then press Mark as shared.
setup.share_remove: Remove {name}'s access ({account}) to DCR Photo & Video in OneDrive, then press Mark as removed.
setup.share_not_company: {name}'s account {account} isn't a DCR Framing account - fix it on the Photo team.
setup.share_done: Everyone on marketing has DCR Photo & Video, as marked.
setup.replace_unproven: Replacing files in OneDrive: not tried yet
setup.reset_ask: Start the photo files setup over? This works only before any shoot has files in OneDrive. Type reset to confirm.
setup.email_switch: E-mail the marketing team when a shoot is ready (DCR Agents 2 sends it). Phone notices are always sent.

folder_fix._about: An admin's fix of a shoot folder (photo_drive_folder_fix, PF §8.9): Retire, once it has been gone 7 days.
folder_fix.retire_ask: Stop using this folder? Its files stay in OneDrive, but DCR counts them as gone, and files handed in from now on go into a new folder.
folder_fix.retire_job_ask: Stop using the job folder '{name}'? Files handed in from now on go into a new job folder. Its shoots that already have files keep their own lines.

health._about: The setup check (photo-files op health, OD §1.3) and the tick's state, one line each, on Desktop 2's setup card and DCR Agents 2's Dashboard. 'ok' shows when none is left but the information-only ones (no_quota, mode_off, mode_test, replace_refused, email_off), which follow it. A word ending _one is the same line when its count is 1, _none when it is 0.
health.ok: OneDrive: connected - DCR Photo & Video in the office OneDrive.
health.not_configured: Photo files aren't set up yet (the owner's one-time Microsoft steps).
health.key_expired: DCR Photo Files' key ran out - the owner makes a new one (DCR Photo Files in Entra).
health.key_invalid: DCR Photo Files' key isn't accepted - the owner makes a new one (DCR Photo Files in Entra).
health.sign_in: DCR Photo Files can't sign in to Microsoft - the owner looks at it (DCR Photo Files in Entra).
health.grant_wider: DCR Photo Files has more Microsoft permissions than it may have - it stopped itself.
health.root_lost: DCR can't reach DCR Photo & Video in OneDrive (deleted, in the recycle bin, moved, or the app's access was taken away).
health.too_wide: Microsoft lets DCR Photo Files see more than its folder - photos are stopped.
health.root_changed: The photo folder setting was changed - put the old one back, or Reset while nothing is in use.
health.no_quota: OneDrive doesn't tell DCR how full it is - DCR counts DCR Photo & Video's own size.
health.key_expiring: DCR's OneDrive key for photos runs out in {n} days - the owner renews it (DCR Photo Files in Entra).
health.key_expiring_one: DCR's OneDrive key for photos runs out tomorrow - the owner renews it (DCR Photo Files in Entra).
health.key_expiring_none: DCR's OneDrive key for photos runs out today - the owner renews it (DCR Photo Files in Entra).
health.onedrive_full: The office OneDrive is full - photo uploads wait. Make room or add storage.
health.storage_low: DCR Photo & Video uses {n}% of its space - make room or add storage.
health.share_todo: {n} marketing members' access to DCR Photo & Video needs changing in OneDrive - see the list below.
health.share_todo_one: 1 marketing member's access to DCR Photo & Video needs changing in OneDrive - see the list below.
health.no_domain: Type the company's e-mail domain - DCR lists only company accounts for sharing.
health.stuck: {n} shoots need someone: a stopped copy or upload, a memory card needed, files that never arrived or that differ, no files handed in, a shoot or job folder gone, or a skipped shoot with files (Photo & Video).
health.stuck_one: 1 shoot needs someone: a stopped copy or upload, a memory card needed, files that never arrived or that differ, no files handed in, a shoot or job folder gone, or a skipped shoot with files (Photo & Video).
health.tick_late: Photo checks haven't run for over 30 minutes - start DCR Agents 2, or keep an admin's DCR Desktop open.
health.mode_test: Photo uploads are being tested on {codes}.
health.replace_refused: OneDrive doesn't let DCR replace a file - Replace keeps OneDrive's copy or leaves the file out.
health.email_off: Ready-for-marketing e-mails are off (phone notices are on).

share._about: A marketing member's line on Users → Photo team (Desktop 2 has the buttons; Portal 2's Access tab shows the line), chosen from the share list (app.photo_share_list) as the share_list cases' lines say; then the phone line. {by}: the first name of the admin who marked it.
share.field_label: Microsoft account (if not their DCR e-mail)
share.field_tip: Marketing members open DCR Photo & Video with their own company Microsoft account - leave this empty when it's their DCR e-mail.
share.to_give: Shoot folders: not shared yet - share DCR Photo & Video with {account} in OneDrive, then press Mark as shared.
share.to_remove: Still has access in OneDrive - remove it, then press Mark as removed.
share.not_company: {account} isn't a DCR Framing account - fix it here, then share DCR Photo & Video with their company account.
share.no_domain: Shoot folders: the company's e-mail domain isn't typed yet (Settings → Photo & Video).
share.phone_off: Phone notices: off - they turn on Phone reminders in the DCR portal on their phone.
share.remove_ask: Take {name} off marketing? Then remove their access to DCR Photo & Video in OneDrive and press Mark as removed.

ready.chip_withdrawn: Taken back - the shoot isn't done any more
ready.waiting_long: On the list for over 2 weeks
ready.files_missing: {n} files are no longer in the folder
ready.files_missing_one: 1 file is no longer in the folder
ready.folder_gone: This shoot's folder is no longer in DCR Photo & Video (moved or deleted in OneDrive) - ask the office to put it back or restore it from OneDrive's recycle bin.
ready.no_access: Ask the office for access to DCR Photo & Video.
ready.access_waiting: The office hasn't given your Microsoft account access to DCR Photo & Video yet - Open in OneDrive shows here once they have.
ready.access_not_company: Your Microsoft account isn't a DCR Framing account - ask the office to fix it on the Photo team.
ready.open_tip: Open the shoot folders on the web or in the OneDrive app - don't sync the whole folder to your computer.
ready.take_over_ask: {name} has been on it since {when}. Take it over?
ready.reopen_ask: Mark it not posted yet? Where it was posted, its link and the note are cleared.
ready.reopen_passed_ask: Put it back on the list? Why it isn't for posting is cleared.
ready.empty: Nothing waiting - shoots show here once they're done and their files are in OneDrive.
ready.empty_done: Nothing posted or passed in the last 90 days.
ready.read_failed: The list couldn't be read - check the connection, then press Try again.
ready.not_yours: Someone else is on it - only they or an admin can do that.
ready.not_yours_reopen: Only the person who marked it, or an admin, can change it back.
ready.too_late_passed: It was marked not for posting over 14 days ago - it can't go back on the list.

hint._about: Refusal HINT codes of the people's RPCs and the photo-files function's codes (OD §4.5, §4.7), in words - DCR Agents 2's failure lines too. {codes}: job codes; {max}: a size; {name}: a file or folder name.
hint.forbidden: You don't have the right to do that.
hint.no_shoot: That shoot isn't on the schedule any more.
hint.not_connected: Photo files aren't set up yet - the office sets them up.
hint.no_folder: This shoot has no folder yet.
hint.open_elsewhere: {by} is copying into this shoot on {pc} (since {when}) - wait until that copy is handed in.
hint.stopped_elsewhere: A copy {by} started on {pc} stopped {when} - finish it first: Copy the rest, Hand in what's there or Cancel it.
hint.name_taken: A different file already has that name here - DCR sends it under a new name.
hint.too_many: This shoot has had 20 hand-ins - ask an admin.
hint.not_yours: That copy was started by someone else.
hint.upload_closed: That copy is already handed in or cancelled.
hint.count_mismatch: Some files didn't reach DCR's list - sending them again.
hint.sealed: That copy is already handed in.
hint.copying: A copy into this shoot isn't finished yet.
hint.too_big: Too much at once - DCR sends it in smaller parts.
hint.too_many_files: This shoot already has 5,000 files - start another shoot for the rest.
hint.rate: Too many tries - wait a minute.
hint.changed: Someone changed this meanwhile - look again.
hint.too_late: It was posted over 14 days ago - it can't be reopened.
hint.reason_needed: Say why it's not for posting.
hint.bad_link: The post's link must start with https://
hint.withdrawn: The shoot isn't done any more.
hint.root_lost: DCR can't reach DCR Photo & Video in OneDrive right now - the office is looking at it (Settings → Photo & Video).
hint.root_changed: The photo folder setting was changed - the office looks at it (Settings → Photo & Video).
hint.folder_gone: This shoot's folder is no longer in DCR Photo & Video - ask the office to put it back.
hint.in_use: Photo files are already in use - they can't be reset.
hint.busy: OneDrive is busy - DCR tries again in a minute.
hint.not_configured: Photo files aren't set up yet (the owner's one-time Microsoft steps).
hint.not_authorized: Photo uploads are stopped - the office is looking at it (Settings → Photo & Video).
hint.too_wide: Photo uploads are stopped - the office is looking at it (Settings → Photo & Video).
hint.uploads_test: Photo uploads are being tested on {codes} - not on for this job yet.
hint.phone_off: Phone uploads are off - use DCR Desktop.
hint.not_this_device: Only the computer or phone that copied these files can send them.
hint.not_same_file: That isn't the file that was recorded - copy it again.
hint.not_waiting: That file isn't waiting to be sent any more.
hint.too_large: That file is bigger than OneDrive takes ({max}).
hint.path_too_long: {name}'s path is too long for OneDrive - shorten the folder or file names.
hint.bad_path: A file named {name} is in the shoot's folder - ask the office to rename it.
hint.folder_name_taken: A folder named {name} is in DCR Photo & Video but DCR didn't make it - ask the office to rename it in OneDrive, then press Try again.
hint.onedrive_full: OneDrive is full - the files wait on this device until the office makes room.
hint.onedrive_failed: OneDrive answered something unexpected - try again later.
hint.bad_mode: Pick off, on, or a test on 1 to 5 job codes (like A267).
hint.bad_domains: Type 1 to 5 e-mail domains, separated by commas (like example.com).
hint.no_item: That shoot isn't on the Ready for marketing list any more.
hint.not_now: That can't be done now - look again.
hint.bad_where: Pick where it was posted from the list.
hint.not_gone: The folder isn't gone - it can be retired only after 7 days missing.
hint.no_answer: No answer from DCR - check the connection, then press it again (it is never done twice).
hint.other: DCR couldn't do that - try again, or ask an admin.

told._about: How each marketing member was told (photo_marketing.told, app.photo_told_entry): completion.told_person's {ways} joins the e-mail and phone words with ', ', the phone first.

help._about: The help notices' push titles (OD §6.6); the bodies are the notice group's, composed as the cases' push section says. Desktop 2 and Portal 2 show a shoot event's title as a 'Needs you' chip on the shoot; the admin events (onedrive_full, onedrive_stopped, key_expiring, storage_low, share_todo) carry no shoot.

notice._about: The phone notices' bodies (push v9 and app.photo_help_text; OD §6.6, §7.5): a shoot's come after '<shoot> - <job>: ' (on a lock screen the names are cut, never these words), the admin events' stand alone. {files}: '12 files' or '1 file'; {pc}: the device's label, else pc_unknown; {n}: an admin event's number (days, a percent; key_expiring's _one twin for 1 day left, _none for 0 or less); no_shoot and no_job stand in for empty names.
notice.late: no progress for 2 hours - is {pc} on and online, with DCR Desktop open?
notice.problem: {files} are different or missing in OneDrive - sort it out in DCR Desktop
notice.problem_one: {files} is different or missing in OneDrive - sort it out in DCR Desktop
notice.stalled: {files} never reached OneDrive - open DCR Desktop on {pc} and let it send them
notice.stalled_one: {files} never reached OneDrive - open DCR Desktop on {pc} and let it send it
notice.stopped: the copy on {pc} stopped after {files} - finish it in DCR Desktop
notice.stopped_none: the copy on {pc} stopped before any file was recorded - finish it in DCR Desktop
notice.stopped_upload_phone: the upload from your phone stopped - finish it on that phone ({files} picked)
notice.stopped_upload_phone_none: the upload from your phone stopped before it began - finish it on that phone
notice.no_hand_in: done 2 days ago, but no files are handed in yet
notice.closed_files: its files are in OneDrive - mark it done to send it to marketing
notice.folder_gone: its folder left DCR Photo & Video - ask the office to put it back or restore it
notice.folder_gone_job: its job folder left DCR Photo & Video - ask the office to put it back or retire it
notice.lost: {files} can't be read on {pc} - put the memory card in and press Copy them again
notice.lost_one: {files} can't be read on {pc} - put the memory card in and press Copy it again
notice.onedrive_full: The office OneDrive is full - photo uploads wait, nothing is lost. Make room or add storage (Settings → Photo & Video).
notice.onedrive_stopped: DCR can't use the office OneDrive right now - DCR Desktop → Settings → Photo & Video says why.
notice.key_expiring: DCR's OneDrive key for photos runs out in {n} days - renew it (DCR Photo Files).
notice.key_expiring_one: DCR's OneDrive key for photos runs out tomorrow - renew it (DCR Photo Files).
notice.key_expiring_none: DCR's OneDrive key for photos runs out today - renew it (DCR Photo Files).
notice.storage_low: DCR Photo & Video uses {n}% of its space - make room or add storage.
notice.share_todo: Give or remove access to DCR Photo & Video in OneDrive, then mark it in DCR Desktop → Users → Photo team.

agents._about: DCR Agents 2 2.3.0: its Dashboard line and Settings → Photo & Video. Its other lines are the health words (the tick's root and setup state) and the hint words (its failure lines: not_configured, not_authorized, uploads_off, busy, rate, onedrive_full, onedrive_failed).
agents.settings_line: Photo checks: every 5 minutes (last {time}: {checked} shoots checked, {ready} ready for marketing).
agents.log: notices: {sent} e-mails sent ({ready} ready for marketing)
agents.log_one: notices: 1 e-mail sent ({ready} ready for marketing)
agents.settings_line_one: Photo checks: every 5 minutes (last {time}: 1 shoot checked, {ready} ready for marketing).
agents.log_failed: {n} e-mail notices failed - they are tried again later
agents.log_failed_one: 1 e-mail notice failed - it is tried again later
agents.log_given_up: {n} e-mail notices failed their 5th and last try - they are not tried again
agents.log_given_up_one: 1 e-mail notice failed its 5th and last try - it is not tried again
agents.not_yet: Photo checks: every 5 minutes (not run yet).
agents.off_paused: DCR Agents 2 is paused - photo checks wait (tray → Resume).
agents.off_standby: Standby - the DCR server computer runs them.
agents.off_sign_in: DCR Agents 2 can't sign in to the DCR database (Settings → Portal).
agents.off_role: DCR Agents 2's account isn't allowed to run them - its role must be agents (DCR Desktop → Users).
agents.off_not_deployed: The photo files function isn't on the DCR server yet (docs/PHOTO-FILES-ONEDRIVE.md §12 step 5).
agents.off_offline: The DCR server didn't answer - trying again in 5 minutes.
agents.mode_off: Photo uploads are off (DCR Desktop → Settings → Photo & Video) - the checks still run.
agents.settings_about: This computer runs DCR's photo checks every 5 minutes: it checks the photographer's files in OneDrive, tells marketing when a shoot is ready and tells the office when something needs a look. The setup is in DCR Desktop → Settings → Photo & Video.
agents.dry_run: They run in dry run too: the checks and marketing's phone notices are the DCR server's. The Ready e-mails are sent by this computer - in dry run they are held for 3 days at most, then dropped unsent.
